name: combat-writing-crew
description: The Combat Writing add-on: a local MCP server that sends each seat's packet to other companies' models on your own API keys, so the crew is the fresh reader plus one seat per outside model you hold a key for. One free Groq key seats two: a crew of three. Each key goes only to its own provider, never to Learning Producers, never into a file. An outside seat's second overrun of the word cap is cut at the cap with its rating kept and marked in the record. Not listed in the Claude plugin directory; installed from the Learning Producers marketplace.

groq_api_key.title: Groq API key
groq_api_key.description: Seats Groq's free models (OpenAI's open-weight line and Alibaba's Qwen line). Sent only to api.groq.com. Leave empty to use the GROQ_API_KEY environment variable instead.

xai_api_key.title: xAI API key
xai_api_key.description: Seats xAI's Grok line. Sent only to api.x.ai. Leave empty to use XAI_API_KEY, or to leave the seat out.

perplexity_api_key.title: Perplexity API key
perplexity_api_key.description: Seats Perplexity's Sonar line. Sent only to api.perplexity.ai. Leave empty to use PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, or to leave the seat out.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Seats OpenAI's GPT line. Sent only to api.openai.com. Leave empty to use OPENAI_API_KEY, or to leave the seat out.

mistral_api_key.title: Mistral API key
mistral_api_key.description: Seats Mistral's large line. Sent only to api.mistral.ai. Leave empty to use MISTRAL_API_KEY, or to leave the seat out.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Seats Google's Gemini line through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Sent only to generativelanguage.googleapis.com. Leave empty to use GEMINI_API_KEY, or to leave the seat out.

ollama_model.title: Ollama model (local, optional)
ollama_model.description: The name of a model your local Ollama serves, such as the one you pulled. Empty leaves the Ollama seat off. Nothing leaves your machine for this seat.
